position: Hosted shape is executable, deployment is not
headline: One adapter can run at an edge or serverless boundary without changing the source contract.
copy: The adapter accepts standard Web Requests and returns standard Web Responses, which keeps the first hosted slice portable and testable.

postures.title: Read routes
postures.copy: Health, sources, search, and source matching are the only routes.

postures.title: Write routes
postures.copy: No mutation, upload, account, review, or telemetry endpoint is present.

postures.title: Origins
postures.copy: GitHub Pages and private local preview origins are accepted; null and unknown origins fail closed.

postures.title: Payload
postures.copy: JSON requests are bounded before source matching.

postures.title: Runtime
postures.copy: The adapter uses Web Request and Response primitives, not provider APIs.

flow.title: Receive
flow.copy: Validate origin, request ID, method, media type, and payload size.

flow.title: Translate
flow.copy: Map the Web Request into the existing read-only source handler.

flow.title: Respond
flow.copy: Return typed JSON and security headers with no-store caching.

flow.title: Stop
flow.copy: Leave deployment, secrets, domains, and writes unconfigured.

decisions.label: Provider
decisions.reason: Portability is proven before infrastructure commitment.

decisions.label: Storage
decisions.reason: The adapter does not add persistence.

decisions.label: Contract
decisions.reason: Browser, local API, and hosted adapter keep one envelope.

decisions.label: Launch
decisions.reason: An executable adapter is not a live service.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, secret, or production runtime is activated.

locks.title: Write lock
locks.copy: No source, rights, reviewer, or learner write route exists.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Role simulations do not authenticate a person or grant production access.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Pilot readiness evidence cannot activate an invitation or public service.
